digest.component_or_area: module-level code structure and size management
propositions: Six high-churn, high-centrality modules sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC cap, with three at exactly 800 LOC, blocking new work due to insufficient headroom

ADR 0056's refactoring method (extracting absorbing verbs, flattening declaration tables, splitting colocated domains) successfully relieved runner.py from 689 to 647 LOC and must be applied to the next tier
config.py and workflow_ops.py require extraction of mass-absorbing patterns to create real headroom without per-function ratcheting (which was rejected as too high blast radius)
Seam tests asserting headroom targets for relieved files and plan-review step-registry membership serve as load-bearing substitutes for the declined per-function length gate
All four children (b00f, d8ef, b300, b5fe) have closed with measured targets met: config.py at 651 LOC (under 700 seam guard), workflow_ops.py at 511 LOC (under 560 target)
